notes: The mechanic is a grant-budget component on the universe handle plus a legality-mask edge. An absent row means unbounded, which is what every save and every hand-built test world written before it carries, so nothing that worked stops working. The three constants also ship at values no run can reach, because the grid holds 300 nodes and only prerequisite-free ones in permitted cells are grantable. WORLD_SCHEMA_VERSION moved 4 to 5; sim-core's SNAPSHOT_VERSION did not move and no golden fixture diffs — goldens:regen was never run.

Measured in tools/w69 over four full 2400-tick runs per strategy: archivist sees action 8 masked for affordability on 4307 of 4804 ticks and for an empty candidate list on zero of them; denial-warden is closed by an empty list on 3508 ticks, having forbidden the grid; narrow-depth sees it legal on 76 percent of its ticks and asks zero times, because encourageResearch sits ahead of it and policyFor takes the first legal preference. Only uniform-random-legal ever grants, and it landed 1 grant from 234 submissions.
rationale: Provenance only. No rule changed and no metric moved for any run this sweep executes: run against the superseded baseline first, every metric read delta 0.00000 at 0.00 SE — exactly zero, not merely inside a three-sigma tolerance. contentRevision moved from 2512ea02d2a7569d8d0bacc4c5a926ca to cd47722ed6fa0a8b3627c6f63fded6f3 because the founding-grant budget added three god constants (founding-grant-budget-start, founding-grant-accrual-nodes, founding-grant-budget-cap), and the gate is right that a delta across two content revisions is a category error. These numbers are a measurement and not a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids any balance claim before 0.5.0. The universe remains degenerate in known ways, and one of them is now measured rather than suspected — no strategy in the pool submits god action 8 even at an unbounded budget, so the founding-grant budget this revision adds cannot reach any metric here, which is why these deltas being exactly zero is expected rather than reassuring. Precedent for a provenance-only re-record: 0bf8437 and 7f46277.
